title: Restoring file & printer sharing
summary: Got staff printing and sharing files again by fixing Windows sharing and printer drivers.
problem: Staff could not reach shared folders or print to the shared office printer.
action: Traced the issue across network discovery, sharing permissions and printer drivers, then reconfigured the shares on the affected PCs.
result: Shared folders and printing restored for the team without replacing hardware.

images.caption: Re-enabling sharing for the office EPSON L220 printer in Windows
